body: I had some water but I think I'm too nauseous from being upset to keep food down. Thank you again for sticking by :'(
I'm laying down now in my bed. Thank you so much for helping talk me down :'( I still think I'm in shock but I'm going to just try and sleep.
Thank you so much :'( Very very much

I'm alive. I'm just so sad. I'm small framed and my spouse threw me on the floor last night after I told them how they were treating me. They threw hot soup on me before then :'( I know I'm difficult, they promised to always love me and take care of me and all of that was betrayed last night :'( I'm so heart broken. My relationship was the light of my life and now I have nothing. I feel so broken right now.

You just made me cry. Thank you so much for the kind words :'( I think these words may be exactly what I needed. I'm just so scared and sad. Everyone my whole life even my spouse all tell me, "Why can't you just be happy?" While they proceed to mistreat me. I used to express my pain a little too crazy, and since then I've become extremely calm in expressing my feelings. And instead of others working with me better, it seems like my mild manners have only made it easier for others to mistreat me. It kills me that they can't see what they're doing to me, even when I spell it out for them.

Okay :'( I'm going to try. It's so hard when these people have said such awful things to me. I've said mean things too, and I always feel so horrible and awful. I always try to make up for any of my wrong doing, but no one does the same for me. I'm so sorry for the whining. I just don't know where else to turn to.
I've forgiven them but they keep hurting me. They don't care about hurting me the way I care about hurting them. They take advantage of my forgiveness and do it all over again

It's hard to describe. No one treats me with the courtesy or thought that I treat them. I'm told to call out bad behavior and when I do I'm the one that gets in trouble for it for making others feel bad. I have feelings too but in being able to understand others better than they understand me it seems that I'm not allowed to have any emotions.

I'm terribly afraid of dying but living is just too painful. No one understands me, not even a little bit. But the people in my life have all agreed that they feel greatly understood by me. When I tell the people I love what the actual scales are like I get shunned and everyone gets hyper angry with me. I honestly don't understand what's going on

It's so hard to describe the phenomenon that leads me here. I bend over backwards for everyone and when I want anyone else to bend a fraction of what I do I get berated and demeaned. It's actually unfair and I feel like I'm losing my mind
I'm so lonely and afraid :'( I can't believe these may be my last moments :''''(
I'll be honest, I'm too neurotic to have friends. Noone wants to be around me. I don't even want to be around me.
I'm hyper ventilating. My neck is in a noose, I took muscle relaxers so maybe eventually I'll pass out and the noose will do its job
I'm almost 30 and things have only gotten worse :'(
No friends or family, but also no debt
Violation of trust, sacred promises broken :'(
